new_candidate_claims.claim: Machine-mediated inquiry may support a hierarchy from knowledge transformation and transfer through conceptual/formal development to population-learned development operators and recursively higher-order principles, but a higher level earns scientific status only through protected residual value beyond strongest lower-level parents.
new_candidate_claims.hard_falsifier: Population regularities fail held-out field/epoch or prospective tests, or mature science-of-science/meta-policy parents reproduce all protected decisions at lower cost.

new_candidate_claims.claim: Relational abstractions induced from multiple source-bound donors can improve later remote-donor retrieval and target decisions beyond fixed lesson injection and strongest structure-mapping/generalization parents.
new_candidate_claims.hard_falsifier: Fixed lessons, semantic retrieval or strongest structural-generalization parent matches discovery at lower cost or induced abstractions increase false analogy.

new_candidate_claims.claim: Some transport failures are best characterized as explicit invariance, functoriality, equivalence or obstruction failures, but these formalisms are used only where native mathematical semantics supports them.
new_candidate_claims.hard_falsifier: The formal additions merely restate native parents or do not change protected transport/reopening decisions.

new_candidate_claims.claim: A scientific controller can prospectively select among direct/native solving, strongest-parent routing, transfer search, conceptual revision, empirical expansion, formalism genesis, recursive meta-learning and abstention using minimum-sufficient escalation rather than universally activating the most complex mode.
new_candidate_claims.hard_falsifier: Always-simple, always-parent or another mature selector matches the protected quality-resource frontier, or the selector causes critical missed escalation/false formalism invention.

existing_claim_extensions.extension: Representation-equivalent restatements must not be counted as substantively independent corroboration; test only where an explicit equivalence/dependence witness exists.

A machine-discovered intermediate representation/formalism is machine-native evidence only when predeclared, causally ablated, resource-matched and independently witnessed; FG90 exploratory inventions alone do not promote the claim.
